ios.desc:
Fittest Fire is a workout logging app where you get points every time you log an exercise.  For strength exercises, points are based on weight and reps. For cardio exercises, points are based on time and distance.

Just click Get Points on the Exercise screen to earn points and also back up all of your exercise data to the Fittest Fire servers. That means if you ever lose or reset your phone, your fitness data will be backed up and secured.

The Fittest Fire app allows you to copy previous workouts and easily see the history of past exercises. The app also includes a calendar, graphs, workout notes, and much more.

Each time you workout, you should push yourself just a bit harder. Increase your reps by 1, add 5 pounds, reduce your 5k time by 10 seconds, etc. Fittest Fire is here to help you on your fitness journey!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fittestfire.com/privacy.html

android.desc:
Do you want to get stronger? If yes, then Fittest Fire is for you!

Fittest Fire is a workout logging app where you get points every you time you log an exercise. These points can be used in the Fittest Fire Game to level up and unlock new abilities. For strength exercises, points are based off weight and reps. For cardio exercises, points are based off time and distance.

If you are not interested in games, you can use the Fittest Fire app as a pure workout tracker. Just click Get Points on the Exercise screen to back up all of your exercise data to the Fittest Fire servers. That means if you ever lose or reset your phone, your fitness data will be backed up and secured.

The Fittest Fire app allows you to copy previous workouts and easily see the history of past exercises. Every time you set a personal record, you will receive a star next to that exercise. The app also contains a calendar with both monthly and daily views.

Each time you workout, you should push yourself just a bit harder. Increase your reps by 1, add 5 pounds, reduce your 5k time by 10 seconds, etc. Fittest Fire is here to help you on your fitness journey!

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made a mobile app and game where you workout to level up

quotes.text:
Hi, I’ve been working on a workout logging mobile app and game to motivate myself to workout called Fittest Fire.

Logging workouts in the mobile app gives you points which are used in the game to increase damage, health, speed, etc.

The mobile apps are native Kotlin / Swift and have been released. The game is currently in demo status but has the level up system in place.

You can easily skip the account creation process for the mobile apps and play around with it first. In that case, you can only save exercises locally. If you have an account, you can save exercises online and get points. Everything is currently free to try (as in beer)

Android App: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.davesprojects.ffandroidxml
iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fittest-fire/id6475898710

Game Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537510/Fittest_Fire/ 
Game Itch: https://dtmcderm.itch.io/fittest-fire

I appreciate any feedback
